items.difficulty_reason: 50 行（含 7 行陈述）、归纳法完整证明：系数正规化 + 沿有限型 Z 子代数下降（constructible 层 colimit 引理）到底情形 stalk=纤维紧上同调，归纳步经基变换归约稠密开集、局部常值分裂、generically finite 引理收缩使补有限、相对正合三角丢弃补、终由局部常值情形引理收口。全链无 omit、每步具名引理。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-constructible-shriek-rel-dim-1 (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4868-4874

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: replace Lambda by Lambda over n so it is a torsion ring; descend Y along its finite type Z-subalgebras using the colimit description of constructible sheaves, reducing to Y Noetherian of finite dimension; induct on the dimension: base case identifies stalks of R^qf_!F with the compact cohomology of the fibre, finite by the two curve lemmas; the step reduces to a dense open V via base change compatibility, splits F into its locally constant part on a dense open U of the affine line and the complementary Z, makes Z finite over Y after shrinking by the generically finite lemma, discards Z through the relative triangle and the quasi-finite constructibility lemma, and finishes with the locally constant case lemma (source lines 4876-4925)
